remotes.title: Magic Remote MR26GA
sources: OLED48C56LB, webOS 10.3.0, 17 November 2026: presses of Netflix, Prime Video, CH+ and CH- read from the remote's input device, and CH+ and CH- received by the key filter
The remote's own picture (server/assets/remotes/MR26GA.png): the buttons printed with a name, as the documented keys
The round button at the top left and the ? button at the top right look like the MR25GA's Home Hub and ? buttons; that they are the same keys is assumed
This remote has no number keys
remotes.notes: The name the TV reports for this remote has not been read yet; LGE MR26GA follows the others' pattern. The list is not marked complete until it has been checked against the remote.
